status: Phase 4. Milestone lists per product are decided as defaults (D56). Owners, criticality, predecessors and applicability conditions are Proposed.
notes: Every milestone has an internal owner role. A milestone is never dropped silently: when the package does not say whether a conditional milestone applies, it is listed with applicability 'unknown'.

Dates: the customer's requested date goes on the delivery milestone; a forecast goes on the milestone its evidence is about (a supplier's date on the supplier milestone, any other forecast on delivery), always with its assumptions; a carrier commitment goes on the delivery milestone only with an approval record. Every other milestone is 'not_estimable': no duration is ever assumed.
Predecessors are used by the dependency graph (Phase 4 step 4).

conditions.cross_connect_any_end: a_end.cross_connect.required or z_end.cross_connect.required is true; false at both ends is not_applicable; otherwise unknown
conditions.supplier_involved: a registered supplier wrote an email in the package; otherwise unknown (no contract field says whether access is off-net)

unknown_actions.note: D60: a conditional milestone whose applicability is unknown creates an action with an owner, shown in the plan and in the workstreams. D62: due in 2 business days from the plan's as-of date by default; configurable here.
